title: Render .bee/verify/ into every runtime skill home, create and update only
action: Give bee a COPY-ONLY render path from .bee/verify/ into every runtime skill home, so a generated verify-<app> skill reaches Claude, Codex and opencode from one source (per D3). It CREATES and UPDATES. It never removes anything, ever (per D6). Shape it on the vendored-expertise precedent at plan.rs:502-509 (copy_expertise) and its apply arm at apply.rs:313-326, NOT on the bee-* skill sync: emit a new plan item per (entry, target) pair whose apply arm writes the rendered bytes, and emit NO removal item of any kind. Resolve the three targets from templates.rs REPO_SKILL_TARGETS, never a hand-written list. Reuse walk_skill_tree and render_skill_bytes so per-runtime bee markers still render, but do NOT reuse list_bee_skill_entries — it filters on the bee- prefix. Handle the root honestly: .bee/verify/ missing, empty, or unreadable each produce zero items and must NEVER block bee's own skill sync; a malformed host-authored SKILL.md under .bee/verify/ reports only its own item and never triggers the whole-tree block_all at skills.rs:696-705. Refuse the root when it is a symlink or when it resolves onto or under a target skills root. The tests are the point of this cell, and the negative one most of all: write it as a HOST fixture — a repo whose runtime home already contains verify-payments/ that bee never generated — and assert it is byte-identical after onboard --apply. Do not write it from the guard's point of view, and do not mirror skills.rs:954.

truths: A verify-* directory present in a runtime skill home and absent from .bee/verify/ is byte-identical before and after onboard --apply
No code path added by this cell can reach apply_remove_skill, remove_dir_all, remove_file or remove_dir
A missing, empty or unreadable .bee/verify/ yields zero plan items and leaves bee-* skill sync fully working
One source entry renders into all three REPO_SKILL_TARGETS homes
Running onboard --apply twice yields an identical tree and an identical plan
